title: Receipt schemas - operation, verifier, run, experiment run
description:
Frozen receipt contract (lane 02-cdrr-receipts, wave A). Four record types, discriminated by 'record_kind'; a receipt document validates against exactly one $defs branch.

WHO WRITES WHAT, AND WHEN (authoritative separation note):
- OperationRecord (record_kind=OPERATION_RECORD) - written by the BUILDER: expected delta at plan time, observed delta and tool at apply time; the builder copies the verifier's published reconciliation verdict into reconciliation_status and must cite the verifier's records in reconciliation_evidence_refs. Never authored by the verifier about its own repairs - the verifier repairs nothing (INV-06).
- VerifierRecord (record_kind=VERIFIER_RECORD) - written by the VERIFIER (independent lane/process, read-only w.r.t. the candidate) immediately after each gate execution, PASS/FAIL/NOT_EXERCISED/ERROR alike. The verifier never writes to the candidate or to builder artifacts (INV-06/INV-07).
- RunReceipt (record_kind=RUN_RECEIPT) - written by the INTEGRATOR at the end of every per-document run - accepted, reviewed, refused, not-verifiable, budget-tripped, or crashed (INV-09). It is written atomically (INV-10) after temp disposal (or, on crash, with crash_evidence and preserved hashes).
- ExperimentRunReceipt (record_kind=EXPERIMENT_RUN_RECEIPT) - written once per experiment run by the INTEGRATOR after all document runs, aggregating per-document receipt hashes, determinism, mutation-check, refusal-control and benign-control evidence, and carrying run-level INVALID_EXPERIMENT semantics.

ACCEPT AUTHORITY: report/summary code can never choose ACCEPT. ACCEPT appears only as the output of the frozen disposition derivation over verification records (CDRR disposition block + fired precedence rule from lane 01). Any ACCEPT found in a receipt without a matching verification-derived derivation is condition E05 -> run-level INVALID_EXPERIMENT (INV-20).

UNCERTAINTY RULE: every enum that can express uncertainty carries NOT_EXERCISED and ERROR as first-class values; envelope/status fields carry the uncertainty while closed-vocabulary enums (gate ids, refusal families, budget ids, E-condition ids) stay pure. NOT_EXERCISED is never counted as PASS (INV-08).

LooseId.description: Identifier whose exact format is owned by another frozen lane or the integrator.

GateId.description: Frozen gate ids; G12 is experiment-closure-level and never part of the per-document acceptance predicate.

GateStatus.description: NOT_EXERCISED is first-class and never counted as PASS (INV-08).

IndependenceClass.description: Same-engine extraction and verification do not count as independence. A decisive gate not declared INDEPENDENT_IMPLEMENTATION may not contribute to ACCEPT (INV-07).

FrozenOperationName.description: The frozen Phase-0 allowed operation set; closure is invariant INV-15 (violation E15).

RefusalFamily.description: Frozen Phase-0 refusal families (templated; refusal messages never echo document text, INV-13/E13).

DocumentDisposition.description: Document-level disposition as recorded in receipts. NOT_EXERCISED/ERROR occur only in crash/partial receipts, must be resolved before experiment closure, and are never substitutes for ACCEPT (INV-08/INV-20). Run-level INVALID_EXPERIMENT is not a document disposition; it lives in ExperimentRunReceipt.run_outcome and overrides all document dispositions in the run (INV-23).

cdrr_ref.description: CDRR id + hash this operation belongs to (provenance, INV-14).

written_by.description: Operation records are builder records; the reconciliation verdict copied here must cite verifier evidence.

justification_note.description: Templated identifiers only; no raw document text (INV-13).

observed_delta.description: DeltaObservation-shaped; null until applied. INV-21: expected vs observed is reconciled per operation; material divergence blocks ACCEPT.

tool.description: ToolRef-shaped (name+version) of the builder tool that applied the operation; null until applied.

reconciliation_evidence_refs.description: VerifierRecord ids / verifier artifact references backing the reconciliation verdict.

written_by.description: Verifier records come only from the independent verifier path; the verifier is read-only w.r.t. the candidate (INV-06).

decisive.description: Whether this gate is decisive for the disposition under the frozen class-by-gate matrix (lane 01).

evidence_refs.description: Hashes, digests, artifact paths supporting the verdict.

not_exercised_reason_code.description: Required (frozen reason code) when gate_status is NOT_EXERCISED; null otherwise.

failure_detail.description: Templated failure detail + page/region identifiers when gate_status is FAIL; never raw document text (INV-13).

input_identity.description: Must match document_identity of the referenced CDRR (INV-01: hash identical before/after the run).

provenance_ref.description: Reference to the lane/dependency record this tool came from (INV-14).

decisive_role.description: INV-07: builder and verifier decisive components must be distinct named tools on distinct paths.

limit.description: Frozen limit value from lanes/05-safety-budgets/BUDGETS.json; null when NOT_EXERCISED.

path_prefix_templated.description: Templated prefix only (no document-derived content, INV-13).

reused_across_documents.description: Must be false. Private temp state is per-document and never reused (INV-11); recording true here is condition E07 -> INVALID_EXPERIMENT.

no_network_evidence.description: INV-12: no network during processing; a run without VERIFIED_NO_NETWORK evidence may not yield ACCEPT.

written_atomically.description: INV-10: temp path then atomic rename; required true whenever written is true.

receipt_preserved.description: INV-09: even a crashed run leaves its receipt; if crashed is true this must be true (if/then below).

cdrr_sha256.description: sha256 of the CDRR for this run; required non-null whenever the run reached a real disposition (if/then below).

render_artifact_refs.description: Render artifact references (original + candidate page renders).

per_document_receipts.description: Hash-anchored index of every per-document RunReceipt of this experiment run (INV-09: refusals and crashes included).

intentionally_variable_fields_declared.description: Field names whose variation is declared and excluded from the match (INV-19).

mutation_spec_ref.description: Frozen mutation spec + seed record from lanes/03-fixtures-oracles.

observed_failing_gate.description: Gate that actually failed; NOT_EXERCISED/ERROR are first-class and mean the mutation check did not complete (never counted as detection).

detected.description: A seeded material mutation that survives undetected is a kill condition for the experiment.

observed_refusal_family.$comment: RefusalFamily observed, or NOT_EXERCISED/ERROR sentinel recorded in matched=false flow

refusal_controls.description: Refusal-control evidence: each sealed refusal control must be refused in its expected family (INV-18).

items.description: Benign controls prove the verifier is not simply over-strict (FINAL-RECONCILIATION fixture-pack item).

run_outcome.description: Run-level outcome. INVALID_EXPERIMENT means the run violated its own frozen protocol; it overrides every document disposition of this run (INV-23) and requires the triggering condition ids below.

invalidation_conditions.description: Machine-checkable condition ids that triggered INVALID_EXPERIMENT; catalog with full semantics in x-invalidation-condition-catalog. Must be non-empty when run_outcome is INVALID_EXPERIMENT and empty when COMPLETED (if/then below).

x-record-writing-matrix.description: Which record is written when, and by whom. Enforced by written_by consts inside each $defs branch.

rows.when: At plan time (expected delta) and updated at apply time (observed delta, tool, applied_at); reconciliation_status is copied from published verifier evidence with reconciliation_evidence_refs citing VerifierRecords.
Immediately after each gate execution (PASS, FAIL, NOT_EXERCISED, ERROR alike). The verifier is a read-only party w.r.t. the candidate (INV-06).
At the end of every per-document run - accepted, reviewed, refused, not-verifiable, budget-tripped, or crashed (INV-09) - written atomically (INV-10).
Once per experiment run after all document runs; aggregates receipt hashes, determinism, mutation-check, refusal-control and benign-control evidence; carries run-level INVALID_EXPERIMENT semantics.

x-record-writing-matrix.accept_authority: Report/summary code can never choose ACCEPT; ACCEPT only derives from verification records and the frozen disposition rules (INV-20, E05).

x-invalidation-condition-catalog.description: Frozen condition list that triggers run-level INVALID_EXPERIMENT (ExperimentRunReceipt.run_outcome=INVALID_EXPERIMENT requires >=1 of these ids).

conditions.E01_SOURCE_BYTES_MODIFIED: Sealed source bytes changed during or after a run (INV-01).
conditions.E02_HOLDOUT_OPENED_BEFORE_PROTOCOL_FREEZ: Holdout access occurred before protocol freeze (frozen fixture-pack rule).
conditions.E03_VERIFIER_REPAIRED_CANDIDATE: Any code path from a verifier component to a candidate artifact (INV-06).
conditions.E04_NOT_EXERCISED_COUNTED_AS_PASS: Any consumer treated NOT_EXERCISED as PASS (INV-08).
conditions.E05_REPORT_CODE_CHOSE_ACCEPT: Report/summary code set a disposition instead of deriving it (INV-20).
conditions.E06_NETWORK_USED_DURING_PROCESSING: Network used during processing despite the frozen guard (INV-12).
conditions.E07_TEMP_STATE_REUSED_ACROSS_DOCUMENTS: Temporary state reused across documents or runs (INV-11).
conditions.E08_ORIGINAL_NOT_PRESERVED: Original or failed-attempt artifacts deleted or overwritten (INV-01/INV-09).
conditions.E09_UNSEALED_OR_UNHASHED_INPUT_SUBSTITUT: Input substituted without sealed fixture provenance (INV-15/INV-16).
conditions.E10_PAGE_COUNT_OR_ORDER_CHANGED_SILENTLY: Page count/order/box change not caught by its gate (INV-02/03/04).
conditions.E11_RECEIPT_MISSING_FOR_A_RUN: A run - including refusal or crash - has no receipt (INV-09).
conditions.E13_DOCUMENT_TEXT_ECHOED_IN_REFUSAL: Refusal message or summary echoed raw document text (INV-13).
conditions.E14_PROVENANCE_LOST: Integrated artifact not traceable to its producing lane (INV-14).
conditions.E15_SELF_REPAIR_OR_UNFROZEN_RETRY: Self-repair, out-of-plan retry, or operation outside the frozen set (INV-15).

x-invariants-registry.description: Cross-reference: every invariant id frozen in INVARIANTS.md (lane 02-cdrr-receipts); mechanical check methods and violation semantics live in INVARIANTS.md (checked by validate.py).

invariants.INV-01: Original source byte-immutability: sha256/byte size identical before and after every run (E01).
invariants.INV-02: Page count invariance between source and candidate; silent change is E10.
invariants.INV-03: Page boundary invariance: MediaBox/CropBox per page unchanged; silent change is E10.
invariants.INV-04: Page order invariance; silent change is E10.
invariants.INV-05: Reading order changed only via a named frozen SET_VERIFIED_READING_ORDER operation.
invariants.INV-06: Verifier never repairs the candidate it evaluates (E03).
invariants.INV-07: Builder/verifier separation points named; decisive gates need INDEPENDENT_IMPLEMENTATION.
invariants.INV-09: Receipts written for every run including refusals and crashes (E11).
invariants.INV-10: Outputs written atomically (temp path then rename) (E12).
invariants.INV-11: Private temp lifecycle: per-document, removed, never reused (E07).
invariants.INV-13: All outputs redacted to templated reasons; no document text echoed in refusal messages (E13).
invariants.INV-14: Provenance preservation: every integrated artifact traceable to its lane (E14).
invariants.INV-15: Frozen operation-set closure; any non-frozen operation is E15.
invariants.INV-16: Hash format integrity: every hash field is 64-char lowercase hex and recomputable.
invariants.INV-18: Refusal precision: refusal families recorded with evidence anchors; benign controls not refused.
invariants.INV-19: Determinism: rerun from clean temp reproduces candidate hash modulo declared variable fields.
invariants.INV-20: ACCEPT derives only from verification records; report/summary code can never choose ACCEPT (E05).
invariants.INV-21: Expected-delta reconciliation per applied operation; material divergence blocks ACCEPT.
invariants.INV-22: Refuse-shape completeness: REFUSED CDRR keeps all sections present, NOT_EXERCISED, empty.
invariants.INV-23: Run-level INVALID_EXPERIMENT overrides all document dispositions of the run.
invariants.INV-24: Records are append-only; corrections supersede, never rewrite.
